Subject: Post-call: IAM evidence & vendor questionnaire

Hi Jane,

Thanks again for your time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and proposed next steps so your security team has what they need to progress the vendor review: 

What we covered
- Redwood SOC 2 Type II: report available (see attached stub).
- IAM capabilities: SSO (SAML & OIDC), SCIM provisioning, RBAC with admin/owner roles, audit logging for admin actions.
- Deployment options: Hosted API (with enterprise BAA for HIPAA customers), Dedicated/Private for stricter isolation and KMS/HSM integration.
- Typical integration flow: 1) exchange SAML metadata / OIDC configs, 2) enable SCIM provisioning (optional), 3) confirm RBAC mapping and admin contacts.

Requested evidence/next steps
1) I'll attach our SOC 2 and a short IAM overview for your review (redwood_soc2_type2_2026.pdf, redwood_iam_overview.pdf).
2) If your team can share a vendor security questionnaire, we can start filling it, alternatively, I can share our standard questionnaire answers in Drive.
3) For technical items (SAML metadata, SCIM schema, RBAC matrix) our SE, Aditya, is looped in and can provide artifacts and a short tech call if useful.

Would you be able to: 
- Confirm the point of contact on your security/compliance team for the questionnaire?
- Share any timeline constraints for the review?

Thanks, I want to keep this low friction. Happy to jump on a 30-min tech call this week if that helps move things along.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>

Hi Jane,

Thanks for the clear asks. I'm the SE on this engagement, attaching the files you requested and answering your HIPAA question below.

Attachments included (stubs):
- saml_metadata.xml (SAML 2.0 metadata with entityID and ACS endpoint)
- scim_schema_v1.json (sample SCIM resource schema and example PATCH request)
- iam_rbac_matrix.csv (high-level role -> permissions mapping)

Quick answers: 
- SAML/OIDC: We support both SAML 2.0 and OIDC; saml_metadata.xml contains the SAML values you can import into your IdP.
- SCIM: We support SCIM 2.0 for user provisioning; scim_schema_v1.json shows attribute mappings. SCIM can be scoped to specific groups/OU attributes.
- RBAC/Admin: iam_rbac_matrix.csv defines Owner, Admin, Developer, and ReadOnly roles. Owners can manage billing and org-level settings; Admins can create/revoke users and view logs.
- HIPAA/BAA: Redwood does offer a BAA for customers handling PHI but it's tied to enterprise contract terms and deployment mode. For Hosted API customers we have an enterprise BAA option; Dedicated/Private deployments are straightforward for HIPAA use (customer-managed network & KMS). Marissa (AE) can route you to our contracts team for the BAA and any required amendments.

Next steps I suggest:
1) I'll upload the SAML/SCIM artifacts to the Drive folder Marissa shared.
2) Marissa, can you confirm who will own the HubSpot record and the contract/PO path?
3) Jane, if you want a 30-min technical call, we have availability tomorrow at 11am PT.

Cheers,
Aditya Rao
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.ai
